# Retry budget spec

The upload loop MUST retry at most 3 times with exponential backoff. Failures after the third attempt SHALL raise `UploadFailed` and file exactly 1 `hydraflow-find` issue via `src/upload.py`.

The reviewer should generally use appropriate judgment where possible. The system will be robust and clean.

All retries write to the escape ledger, which never records duplicates. The optimizer edits `src/upload.py` directly when the retry budget is exceeded.
